final: WITH pattern_avgs AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern`, AVG(`aCL IgG`) as pattern_avg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND `aCL IgG` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), cross_avg AS (SELECT AVG(pattern_avg) as overall_avg FROM pattern_avgs), above_avg_patterns AS (SELECT p.`ANA Pattern`, p.pattern_avg FROM pattern_avgs p, cross_avg c WHERE p.pattern_avg > c.overall_avg), above_avg_mean AS (SELECT AVG(pattern_avg) as avg_of_above FROM above_avg_patterns) SELECT a.`ANA Pattern`, ROUND(a.pattern_avg, 2) as avg_acl_igg, ROUND(a.pattern_avg - (SELECT overall_avg FROM cross_avg), 2) as above_overall, ROUND(a.pattern_avg - (SELECT avg_of_above FROM above_avg_mean), 2) as diff_from_above_avg_mean FROM above_avg_patterns a ORDER BY a.pattern_avg DESC
